systems.owner: Malagasy authorities, backed by the OIF's « État civil » project
systems.tiers: described as relying on biometric registration to make up arrears in birth registration; no tier stated

note: Gives MICS 2025 shares of under-fives without a birth certificate (near 20%; 21% rural, a little over 12% urban), which are shares of children, not of offices; describes no system by which an office registers an event digitally.
